canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Lanel Vesho: 27-year-old woman, 154 cm (very-short), healthy slight, narrow, long-limbed construction with low mass, skin value band-4-medium. Face: angular diamond face; asymmetric brows and broad cheek planes; flat broad nose, defined cupid's bow; faint freckles. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: multicolor-split-streak, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: asymmetric-patchwork, specifically intentional patchwork layers with an uneven hem, visible repairs, and practical trousers; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette moss-ivory. Visible personal details: an extensive patchwork of ordinary ink marks across the arms and upper back. Make the hair construction the primary recognition silhouette. Maintenance cue: immaculate clothes over weathered hands. Color treatment: keeps color restrained to layered edges. Pose cue: weight settles into one heel, shoulders square, hands relaxed and completely visible. Include a travel tally cord only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
